Title: Credit Card Payoff Calculator: How Long Will It Take?
Description: Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 card at 22% APR takes over 19 years and costs about $8,100 in interest. A fixed $250 a month clears it in 26 months. See your own payoff date and interest, free, no sign-up.

Title: Debt Snowball vs Avalanche Calculator (Free)
Description: Snowball pays the smallest balance first; avalanche pays the highest interest rate first. Enter your own debts to see your debt-free date, total interest, and payoff order under both methods. Free, no sign-up, nothing leaves your browser.

Title: 2026 Quarterly Estimated Tax Due Dates for Freelancers
Description: The fourth 2026 estimated tax payment is due January 15, 2027. Self-employed people usually need to pay quarterly if they expect to owe $1,000 or more. The free calculator works out your payment with the IRS 1040-ES worksheet and safe harbor rules.

Title: How Much to Set Aside for Taxes as a Freelancer (2026)
Description: With no other income, a single freelancer with $60,000 of 2026 profit owes about $12,037 in federal income and self-employment tax, roughly 20%. Use the free calculator to get your own quarterly estimated tax payment, based on the IRS Form 1040-ES worksheet.

Title: Loan Calculator With Extra Payments (Free)
Description: On a $25,000 car loan at 7% for 60 months, paying $100 extra a month pays it off 11 months early and saves $938.99 in interest. Try your own loan, extra payments, or a lump sum, with a full amortization schedule.

Title: Debt Payoff Calculator: See Your Debt-Free Date
Description: Keep paying the same total each month and roll each paid-off debt's payment into the next one. In this example, $200 extra a month gets you debt-free 20 months sooner and saves $3,554 in interest. Free calculator, snowball or avalanche.

Title: Estimated Tax Safe Harbor: Pay 100% of Last Year's Tax
Description: You can avoid the underpayment penalty by paying the smaller of 90% of this year's tax or 100% of last year's (110% if your AGI was over $150,000). With $90,000 of profit and $9,000 of tax last year, that's $2,250 a quarter instead of $4,346. The free calculator follows the IRS Form 1040-ES worksheet.

Title: Savings Goal Calculator: How Long to Save $10,000
Description: At 4% APY, saving $300 a month reaches $10,000 in 32 months; $500 a month gets there in 20. Enter your goal, what you have, and your rate to see your date or the monthly amount you need. Free, no sign-up.

Title: 50/30/20 Budget Calculator (Free)
Description: The 50/30/20 rule splits take-home pay into needs, wants, and savings. On $4,000 a month that's $2,000, $1,200, and $800. Enter your own pay and, if you like, what you spend now to see where you stand.

Title: Free Printable Mileage Log (PDF) for 2026 Taxes
Description: A free one-page mileage log for business driving: date, destination, business purpose, odometer start and end, miles, and parking and tolls, the record items IRS Publication 463 lists. US Letter PDF, black and white, with a page explaining what to write and the 2026 rates (72.5 cents to June 30, 76 cents from July 1). No sign-up.

Title: Self-Employment Tax Explained: 15.3% for Freelancers
Description: Employees split Social Security and Medicare with their employer; self-employed people pay both halves: 15.3% on 92.35% of profit, with Social Security capped at $184,500 of earnings in 2026. Half of it is deductible. Work out yours with the free self-employment tax calculator.

Title: Freelancer Tax Tracker Spreadsheet (Excel)
Description: Log what you earn and spend; the spreadsheet sorts expenses into Schedule C lines, works out each quarterly estimated tax payment with the IRS worksheet, and tracks what you've paid against every due date. 2026 and 2027, all filing statuses.

Title: Loan Calculator: 36 vs 48 vs 60 Month Loan Interest
Description: On a $20,000 loan at 8%, stretching from 36 to 60 months drops the payment from $626.73 to $405.53 a month but raises total interest from $2,562.18 to $4,331.67. See your payment, interest, and what extra payments save. Free, no sign-up.

Title: Free Printable Daily Tip Log for Servers and Bartenders (PDF)
Description: A free one-month tip log: cash tips, card tips, tips from others, tips paid out with names, and tips kept, the daily record IRS Publication 531 asks tipped employees to keep. Includes a box for the report due to your employer by the 10th of the next month and notes on the new tips deduction (up to $25,000 for 2025-2028). US Letter PDF, no sign-up.

Title: Debt Payoff Planner Spreadsheet: Snowball + Avalanche (Excel)
Description: Enter your debts once and get a month-by-month plan for both the snowball and avalanche methods, your debt-free date, total interest, payoff order, and a payment log to track your real progress.

Title: Home Office Deduction Calculator: Simplified vs Regular
Description: A freelancer renting a 1,000 sq ft apartment for $1,800 a month, with a 150 sq ft office, deducts $750 with the simplified method but $3,630 with the regular method (Form 8829). Compare both with your rent, utilities, and office size. Follows IRS Pub 587.

Title: Free Printable Income and Expense Log for Self-Employed (PDF)
Description: A free income and expense log for freelancers and small businesses: date, payer or payee, what it was for, a Schedule C line code, income, expense, and receipt kept. The 2026 Schedule C line key is printed on the sheet, and page 2 covers what IRS Publication 583 says your books must show. US Letter PDF, no sign-up.
